messages:
Anya: Heads-up — we're consolidating the inbound playbook visuals for the Q3 cohort push. Need a hero diagram + three benchmark tiles + a 1-slide webinar hero. Deadline: EOD Friday.
Mira: Got it. Can you share the use cases and routing that need to be illustrated?
Anya: Main pieces: 1) Launch social post -> landing hero (lead capture) 2) Webinar signup flow -> cohort nurture 3) Benchmark tile comparing latency/cost for hosted vs dedicated. Also need small routing diagram for SDR handoff and lead scoring buckets.
Sam: For routing: want clarity on where high-value MQLs (>=60% score) go — immediate SDR queue + Slack alert. Lower intent goes into 7-day nurture drip.
Jackie: Branding notes — use the updated palette (navy+coral+muted-green), prefer the new type scale (H1: Inter 48/semibold). Keep tiles simple: icon + 3 metrics + 1-line takeaway.
Mira: Cool. Can you drop the exact metrics for the benchmark tile? I can mock layout once I have numbers.
Anya: Bench numbers: Hosted (p50 latency 85ms, cost/token $0.0025), Dedicated (p50 65ms, cost/token $0.0016), Private (p50 72ms, cost/token $0.0020). Highlight: Dedicated = best cost per token at scale. Use sparkline for cost.
Jackie: Also add callout: "Unified API + predictable economics" as the 1-line takeaway for the tiles.
Mira: Noted. Any localization variants?
Anya: Yes — US EN and EU EN copy only for now. Keep copy concise.
Sam: For the routing diagram, here's the simple YAML the product team will use in infra — could be useful to visualise in the diagram:
```
routes:
  - name: high_intent
    match: score >= 60
    action: send_to_sdr_queue + slack_alert(#sdr-high)
  - name: nurture
    match: score < 60
    action: add_to_drip(days=7)
```
Mira: Perfect, that helps. Will design an arrow flow and small legend.
Anya: For deliverables: Figma file with separate pages for hero/tiles/routing + PNG exports at 1200x628 for social and 1920x1080 for webinar hero. Also need a localizable figma text layer.
Mira: Timeline check — I can do first drafts by Thu noon, final by Fri EOD. Need legal signoff for the benchmark claims.
Anya: @Leo can you review the benchmark language for accuracy and compliance?
Leo: I can review by Thu afternoon. Quick note: avoid absolute phrasing like "cheapest" — use "most cost-efficient at scale". Also include a short footnote: metrics based on internal Redwood performance tests, June 2025.
Jackie: Good catch. We'll prep a legal-friendly footnote.
Mira: Design questions: preferred iconography style? Flat or outline?
Jackie: Use flat icons with 2-color fills to match the new palette. Keep stroke minimal.
Mira: Ok. Also confirm: is the webinar hero a static image or animated GIF?
Anya: Static for the landing, GIF optional for socials (separate ticket). For this thread just static exports.
Mira: Noting export specs: PNG 1200x628 + 640x360 thumbnails + 1920x1080. I'll include a figma tokens page for colors and type.
Sam: For the CTA on hero: "Join our benchmark webinar — register" (short) and for tiles CTA small link: "See the full benchmark".
Anya: Include UTM examples: utm_campaign=cohort_q3&utm_source=social. Design can add space for microcopy.
Mira: Will mock. tagging design-bot to add asset checklist.
design-bot: Checklist created: [Figma master file, PNG 1200x628, PNG 640x360, PNG 1920x1080, source SVG icons, localization-ready text layers, export log]. (auto-note)
Mira: Uploading the draft figma link shortly — will post in thread when ready.
Anya: Thanks — once draft is up, I'll run copy pass. Jackie will add brand QA and Leo will confirm legal.
Jackie: I'll do brand sweep Thu evening. If all good, we can hand to growth for scheduled posts next week.
Anya: One more ask — can we include a tiny diagram explaining "automatic fallback" in the benchmark tile (like small icon + text: fallback to compatible model variants)? It's quick and helps product messaging.
Mira: ok small badge in corner of the tile.
Sam: FYI — need the final pngs by Mon AM for paid channels. Mira's Friday EOD timeline works.
Anya: Great. Thanks everyone. I'll post the content brief and tracking links when drafts are live. :rocket:
Mira: Draft uploaded: https://www.figma.com/file/EXAMPLE/Inbound-Playbook-Hero — feedback welcome.
Jackie: Reviewing now.
Leo: Will review benchmark copy after Jackie finishes brand sweep.
Anya: Closing loop — please add reactions on the figma comments rather than long threads here.
Mira: Will do.
Jackie: ✅
Sam: ✅
Leo: ✅
